verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item documents an export feature. The only support for leaving with your data is indirect: MIT-licensed Community Edition self-hosting with 'full data ownership', and an MCP server and CLI that let an agent or terminal read and manage collections and environments. Community reports also note that workspace data can't be pointed at a local directory, and Git/.http-file sync was a feature request rather than a shipped capability. Missing for 10: documented full-data export (collections, environments, teams, history), explicit open export formats such as OpenAPI, Postman or .http files, and independent confirmation of a complete migration-out path.
